wrap_autoreset_gym_env: wrap a gym environment with AutoReset to automatically reset when an episode is done
wrap_actionrepeat_gym_env: wrap a gym environment with ActionRepeat to repeat the same action for multiple consecutive steps
wrap_randomstart_gym_env: wrap a gym environment with RandomStart to perform random actions at the start of each episode
wrap_framehistory_gym_env: wrap a gym environment with FrameHistory to augment observations with a ring buffer of past frames
wrap_externalprocess_gym_env: wrap a gym environment with ExternalProcess to step it in a separate multiprocessing worker process
